articles_review_fields_only.name: articles_review_fields_only
articles_review_fields_only.value: "articles"."kind" = 'review' or ("articles"."game_id" is null and "articles"."score" is null and "articles"."score_details" is null and "articles"."rarity_key" is null and "articles"."score_reason" is null and "articles"."verdict" is null)

articles_review_complete.name: articles_review_complete
articles_review_complete.value: "articles"."kind" <> 'review' or "articles"."status" <> 'published' or ("articles"."game_id" is not null and "articles"."score" is not null and "articles"."score" between 0 and 100 and char_length(btrim(coalesce("articles"."score_reason", ''))) >= 20 and char_length(btrim(coalesce("articles"."verdict", ''))) >= 10)

articles_news_fields_only.name: articles_news_fields_only
articles_news_fields_only.value: "articles"."kind" = 'news' or ("articles"."category" is null and "articles"."source_name" is null and "articles"."source_url" is null)

articles_video_together.name: articles_video_together
articles_video_together.value: ("articles"."video_url" is null and "articles"."video_title" is null) or ("articles"."video_url" is not null and "articles"."video_title" is not null)

games_external_source_and_id_together.name: games_external_source_and_id_together
games_external_source_and_id_together.value: ("games"."external_source" is null and "games"."external_id" is null) or ("games"."external_source" is not null and "games"."external_id" is not null)
